game_concept: A speed quiz set in Mt. Pyre – Pyre Summit, the roaring summit: the volcanologist must handle fire sprites while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Modulo Gate: Use % to decide which gates in Pyre Summit open (even, odd, divisible by 3).
theme: Mt. Pyre – Pyre Summit: the roaring summit
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Read a rectangle's width and height. Calculate its area and display the result. Test dataset 8: {'width': 9, 'height': 10}; {'width': 11, 'height': 2}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Modulo Gate' (Week 2 slot 3), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Pyre Summit'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Collect 180 points of ember crystals by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
source_lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 180, or lives reach 0.
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
